sources.title: Carakasaṃhitā (A SARIT edition)
sources.edition: E-text based on the 1941 Nirṇayasāgara edition of Yādavaśarman Trivikramātmaja Ācārya (Kyoto etext archive input by T. Yamashita, Y. Muroya, Y. Yamanaka, Madhu K. P.); TEI encoding by Dominik Wujastyk (SARIT).
sources.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (as declared in the TEI header <availability>)
sources.license_evidence: TEI header publicationStmt/availability of the pinned file; note the header also carries status="restricted" and 'Copyright 2014-2018 SARIT'. Recorded as an open rights question, not resolved.
sources.extraction_method:
pramaan.corpus.tei v1 (lxml, external entities and network disabled; /

xml:id locators;
known_limitations: Verse numbers are those encoded in SARIT xml:id attributes (Ca.<sthāna>.<adhyāya>.<verse><pāda>); they may differ from other printed editions.
Chakrapāṇidatta's commentary is NOT included in this e-text; only mūla text.
Editorial symbols (&, +, *, ---) from the Kyoto e-text are preserved unchanged in the original text field.
No page numbers are available; none are shown.

sources.title: Aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitā (A SARIT edition)
sources.edition: Base e-text by R. P. Das and R. E. Emmerick (later printed as 'Vāgbhaṭa's Aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitā: the romanised text...', Groningen: Egbert Forsten, 1998); TEI conversion by Richard Mahoney / Patrick McAllister; maintained for SARIT by Dominik Wujastyk.
sources.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported (as declared in the TEI header <availability>)
sources.license_evidence: TEI header of the pinned file; the header also records the base-text authors' permission for free distribution of the e-text.
sources.extraction_method: pramaan.corpus.tei v1 (variant-reading <note> elements stored separately from base text)
known_limitations: Verse numbers come from SARIT xml:id (Ah.<part>.<chapter>.<verse>); additional verses are encoded as e.g. 27+1 and shown that way.
Hyphens marking compound boundaries are editorial and kept in the original text.
<pb> page breaks exist but the edition they refer to is not stated; PRAMAAN does not display page numbers.
Aruṇadatta / Hemādri commentaries are not included.

sources.title: Ashwagandha: Usefulness and Safety
sources.license: Page states it is not copyrighted and is in the public domain. PRAMAAN stores short paraphrases with attribution, not a copy of the page.
sources.extraction_method: Manual paraphrase by build assistant from a fetched copy; short quoted phrases under 15 words.
known_limitations: US federal consumer-health summary; scope is ashwagandha supplements/preparations generally, not specific classical formulations, routes or doses.
Not a comprehensive interaction database. Statements must not be generalised to other herbs or to formulations containing ashwagandha without review.
No pinned hash: web page content can change; re-check before submission.
